summary.title: Arm CPU Telemetry Solution Topdown Methodology Specification
summary.one_liner: An Arm specification describing the Topdown methodology and telemetry framework for locating CPU performance bottlenecks with profiling tools.
takeaways: The Arm CPU Telemetry Solution includes a Topdown methodology and a telemetry framework for CPU performance analysis.
The Topdown methodology can be used with profiling tools to investigate and analyze CPU performance issues.
The specification is aimed at engineers collecting and analyzing CPU telemetry, and at architects doing resource characterization and platform tuning.
Per the listing summary, Arm's top-down approach is staged stall accounting: first locate the bottleneck, then measure its resource.
summary.summary: This Arm document (issue 02_02, dated 2025-09-10) is a specification for the Arm CPU Telemetry Solution Topdown Methodology. According to the meta description, it introduces the telemetry solution and its components, including the Topdown methodology and telemetry framework, and explains how to use Topdown with profiling tools to analyze CPU performance issues. The page text shown is mostly front matter (copyright, audience, feedback), so the technical method details were not visible; the staged stall accounting description comes from the listing note.
